title: Carleson families of cubes related to porous sets
summary: Given a porous set $E\in \mathbb{R}^d$ and a dyadic lattice $\mathcal{D}$, we refine the Carleson packing condition and the sparseness property for the dyadic cover $\mathcal{D}_E=\{Q \in \mathcal{D}: \: Q \cap E \neq \varnothing\}$. We study the inverse problem, when a Carleson family $\mathcal{S} \subset \mathcal{D}$ generates the porous set $E$ such that $\mathcal{S} \subset \mathcal{D}_E$.
